title: Art is good, captions suck
text: I love Critical Role, and love the LoVM. Was really excited to see this subscription box. But while the art is great, Amazon insists on adding stupid captions to almost every shirt. The Scanlan one was the worst, Grog only a bit better. You don't need to explain the characters to your audience! We already love them, that's why we bought the shirt! Let the art speak for itself!
label: neutral
